summary: @ornikar/jest-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute opaque bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Jest configuration preset but ships a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a 727KB opaque Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) shipped in the tarball. `setup.mjs` itself is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers and string-lookup maps), and `math_init.js` is a Bun-only compiled binary with a shuffled constant table whose behavior is not statically inspectable. The bundled payload is not referenced anywhere else in the package, is undocumented, and has no relationship to Jest configuration. Installing the package causes an alternate-runtime dropper to fetch a second language runtime and execute attacker-shipped opaque code on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
